what: a tapered extrude of a loop of arcs on three circles meeting at sharp corners (a circle with a lobe on each side); the walls must meet at the corners
method: the section at depth z is the profile offset inward by z*tan45 = z: the union of the circle R 49.2 -> 49.2-z (centre 0) and two lobes r 16.2 -> 16.2-z (centres +-41). Area(z) = pi*R'^2 + 2*(pi*r'^2 - lens(R', r', d=41)) with the circle-circle lens in closed form; V = Int Area(z) dz over z in 0..2.5 (Simpson) = 18907.67. Faces: top, bottom, 4 walls
